Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task

All video frames are processed in the browser. This application does not record
or upload camera footage. Model and runtime files are served with the application.
